name: L10nLocaleConfig
doc: One locale's configuration, stored as l_config in its localization document.

fields.name: locale
fields.doc: Canonical BCP-47 locale identifier such as ar-EG.

fields.name: fallback
fields.doc: Additional fallback locales, followed after the locale's structural parents.

fields.name: rtl
fields.doc: Mirror layout boxes; glyph shaping and logical reading order remain intact.

fields.name: fonts
fields.doc: Ordered family/resources for this locale, inherited through fallback.
